name: Proposal viewed: update the deal in Pipedrive

parameters.method: ={{ (Array.isArray($json.data) ? $json.data : []).find(n => String(n.content || '').includes('Proposal views (kept up to date automatically)')) ? 'PUT' : 'POST' }}
parameters.url: ={{ 'https://api.pipedrive.com/v1/notes' + (((Array.isArray($json.data) ? $json.data : []).find(n => String(n.content || '').includes('Proposal views (kept up to date automatically)'))) ? '/' + ((Array.isArray($json.data) ? $json.data : []).find(n => String(n.content || '').includes('Proposal views (kept up to date automatically)'))).id : '') }}
parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ deal_id: $('Pick deal').item.json.deal_id, pinned_to_deal_flag: 1, user_id: 32883646, content: 'Proposal views (kept up to date automatically)
Opened ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.views + ' time(s). Last opened ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.last_text + '.
Proposal: ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.bid_link + '

Every open:
' + $('Pick deal').item.json.history }) }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Pick deal').item.json.task === true && !((($('Update deal').item.json.data || {}).next_activity_type === 'call') && String(($('Update deal').item.json.data || {}).next_activity_date || '9999') <= $now.setZone('America/Winnipeg').plus({ days: 2 }).toISODate()) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: 'Call ' + ($('Pick deal').item.json.dm_name || $('Pick deal').item.json.company) + ': ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.company + ' ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.why, type: 'call', done: 0, user_id: 32883646, deal_id: $('Pick deal').item.json.deal_id, person_id: $('Pick deal').item.json.person_id || undefined, due_date: $now.setZone('America/Winnipeg').toISODate(), note: (($('Pick deal').item.json.dm_name || $('Pick deal').item.json.company) + ' ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.why + ' (' + $('Pick deal').item.json.views + ' opens, last ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.last_text + '). ' + ($('Pick deal').item.json.dm_phone ? 'Phone ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.dm_phone + '. ' : '') + 'Proposal: ' + $('Pick deal').item.json.bid_link) }) }}
